name: Check WireGuard Interface
description: Confirms the VPN data plane and the web UI, not just a running container: the wireguard kernel module is loaded on the host, the init wrapper enabled IP forwarding in the container's network namespace, wg-easy brought up wg0 (pct exec ... wg show wg0), the SSL addon's nginx answers HTTPS on local_https_port, and wg-easy's plain HTTP port is blocked from outside.
